Job Summary

JCS Solutions is seeking a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst supporting the Pentagon Reservation under the DISA Penetration Handling, Incident, System Health (PHISH) Support Services II program. This position supports a 24/7 SOC mission and requires availability for rotating shifts, including weekends, holidays, and inclement-weather operations. The position requires 60 percent onsite work at the Mark Center in Alexandria, Virginia, consistent with program and customer requirements.

The Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst supports continuous monitoring, detection, analysis, escalation, mitigation, and response to cybersecurity events affecting customer networks, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud environments, and mission systems. The analyst uses security telemetry, threat intelligence, established analytic procedures, and operational tools to identify suspicious or malicious activity; investigate potential compromises; document findings; and coordinate response actions with senior analysts, incident responders, cyber engineers, system owners, and mission partners.

This role is an experienced technical individual-contributor position. The SOC Analyst works independently to achieve day-to-day operational objectives and may own defined projects or technical processes within the SOC. The analyst contributes to operational cybersecurity, infrastructure support, and mission-support activities; collaborates with internal subject-matter experts to resolve technical problems; and may provide peer support, coaching, or technical review for less-experienced personnel.

Location: Alexandria, VA

Clearance: TS/SCI

Certification: Active DoD 8140/8570 IAT Level II certification

What’s in it for you:

  • Join a premier technology firm specializing in innovative solutions.
  • Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work culture.
  • Enjoy tremendous growth potential in a high-performing team environment.
  • A robust benefits package:
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance
    • Life insurance
    • Short-and-long term disability
    • Paid time off (PTO)
    • 401k retirement plan with employer match
    • Annual Professional Development Reimbursement Program
    • And more!
What you will do:

  • Monitor, triage, and investigate alerts from Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools, intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS), authentication logs, NetFlow, packet capture, cloud-security tools, vulnerability data, and other available security sensors.
  • Analyze endpoint, host, network, identity, application, and cloud telemetry to identify anomalous, suspicious, or malicious activity.
  • Conduct assigned incident investigations by reviewing security logs and alerts, correlating evidence across available data sources, identifying potentially affected systems or accounts, assessing scope and potential impact, and escalating cases in accordance with established procedures.
  • Apply cyber threat intelligence and knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to validate alerts, identify indicators of compromise, prioritize investigations, and provide relevant context to incident responders and technical stakeholders.
  • Support approved containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities by collecting evidence, documenting actions, validating security controls, and coordinating with designated response personnel.
  • Perform computer forensic network and host analysis in support of incident investigations, threat-hunting activities, and evidence-based reporting.
  • Support proactive threat hunts, environment sweeps, and detection-validation activities based on known or emerging adversary activity, vulnerabilities, and organizational priorities.
  • Identify recurring false positives, control gaps, telemetry limitations, suspicious trends, vulnerabilities, and adversary behaviors; recommend improvements to detection logic, dashboards, analytic workflows, playbooks, and SOC processes.
  • Contribute to the development, testing, tuning, and documentation of detection use cases, correlation logic, analytic playbooks, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge-management artifacts.
  • Document analytic methods, evidence, findings, actions taken, escalation decisions, and recommended next steps in case-management and knowledge-management systems.
  • Prepare clear incident tickets, shift summaries, situational-awareness updates, and technical reports for SOC personnel, incident responders, system owners, and operational stakeholders.
  • Conduct authorized infrastructure-support activities, including device discovery, operating-system fingerprinting, service scanning, passive network scanning, and support to the configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance of cybersecurity hardware and software.
  • Maintain proficiency with operational tools, cyber-defense methodologies, network and host analysis techniques, and evolving threats.
  • Support training, exercises, operational planning, and integrated cyber operations as assigned.
  • Collaborate with SOC operations, incident response, cyber engineering, threat intelligence, system administrators, and mission partners to share findings and support timely remediation.
  • Provide technical guidance, peer review, and knowledge sharing to junior analysts or other team members, as assigned.

What you will bring:

  • Experience supporting a SOC, CND organization, cyber protection team, incident-response team, network operations center, or comparable cybersecurity operations environment.
  • Experience monitoring and investigating cybersecurity events using SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, endpoint, network, identity, cloud, vulnerability, and log-data sources.
  • Working knowledge of incident-response processes, including alert triage, investigation, escalation, evidence collection, containment support, remediation coordination, and incident documentation.
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP; common ports and protocols; network traffic flow; endpoint and operating-system fundamentals; authentication and identity activity; and enterprise security controls.
  • Familiarity with adversary TTPs, attack vectors, indicators of compromise, common malware behaviors, and analytic frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
  • Ability to analyze available data, identify gaps or uncertainties, apply established procedures, and communicate technically sound findings and recommendations.
  • Ability to prepare clear case notes, incident summaries, shift-turnover products, and technical reports for technical and operational audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across SOC operations, incident response, cyber engineering, system administration, and customer or mission-partner organizations.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned operational objectives, technical processes, or projects, while recognizing when to seek assistance or escalate risk.
  • Required Certifications
    • An active DoD 8140 IAT Level II certification, such as one of the following: Security+ CE, CySA+, CASP+ CE, CCNA-Security, CCNP Security, CCSP, CISA, CISSP (or Associate), CND, GCED, GCIH, GICSP, GSEC, or SSCP
  • Education Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, intelligence studies, or a related technical discipline, and 4-8 years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of relevant military service, cybersecurity education, certifications, and professional experience.
How you will wow us:

  • Experience using one or more enterprise SIEM platforms, such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ArcSight, Elastic, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with EDR, antivirus, host-based security tools, IDS/IPS, network detection and response, vulnerability-management tools, NetFlow, or packet-capture analysis.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems, command-line tools, and system-administration concepts.
  • Experience with structured threat hunting, detection tuning, use-case development, or translating threat intelligence into analytic queries.
  • Familiarity with malicious-file triage, malware-analysis concepts, network-forensics techniques, or host-forensics artifacts.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or a similar language.

Role Summary

The Security Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day implementation, monitoring, analysis, and maintenance of the organization's cybersecurity controls. This role supports identity and access management, endpoint and network security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, compliance, and security awareness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to cybersecurity incidents, including phishing attempts, malware infections, compromised accounts, and unauthorized access events.

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.

descriptionHtml:
At Aristocrat, we are passionate about delivering world-class gaming experiences that bring happiness to millions of players worldwide. We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Security Operations Analyst (Tier 2) to join our team. As part of our Security Operations Center, you will play a crucial role in protecting our digital assets and maintaining our flawless security standards. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to collaborate with global teams, grow within a structured mentoring program, and build your career in a modern SOC environment. If you are ambitious and ready to compete at the highest level, this role is for you!

What You'll Do
  • Own MSSP customer concerns and medium/high-severity alerts from start to finish. Scope the activity and build the timeline. Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and investigate endpoint, identity, network, and cloud data to reach a defensible conclusion.
  • Review a sample of MSSP triage for quality, offering tuning, detection-gap, and escalation-criteria feedback to the MSSP.
  • Triage phishing (header analysis, sandboxing), malware (static & sandbox), and credential-compromise investigations.
  • Complete containment and remediation within approved playbooks — host isolation, account disablement, credential reset, IOC blocking — and record every action taken.
  • Raise issues to senior specialists with a full set of information: hypothesis, evidence, actions taken, current risk, and specific ask; send well-understood benign patterns back to the MSSP along with a detailed disposition and the missing playbook step.
  • Build and run queries across our SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms and MSSP tooling to support investigations and reporting.
  • Identify detection and tuning gaps. Flag false positives and propose tuning, suppression, or enrichment with supporting evidence. Test and validate detection changes shipped by the detection engineering team.
  • Document every case to a high standard. Ensure it is complete, accurate, and reproducible by someone not on shift. Accept peer and lead QA review. Act on feedback within the same cycle.
  • Support specialist-led threat hunts and incident response — evidence gathering and technical analysis from detection through root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Contribute to playbook, runbook, and knowledge-base improvements drawn from your own casework.
  • Participate in the 24x7 rotating shift roster, including on-call and occasional weekend coverage.

What We're Looking For
  • 2+ years of hands-on SOC / security operations experience, with ownership of investigations beyond initial triage.
  • A bachelor's degree in information systems, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Query proficiency on our CrowdStrike stack — CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) — or transferable SIEM query experience (e.g., KQL, SPL); plus hands-on EDR (live response, process-tree analysis, host isolation).
  • Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory (AD) / Entra ID attack patterns; comfortable reading authentication, process, and network logs without a playbook.
  • A solid grasp of the incident-response process, phishing and malware investigations; MITRE ATT&CK for mapping observed behavior.
  • Nice to have: Security+, ISC2 SSCP, Microsoft SC-200, CrowdStrike (CCFA/CCFR), Blue Team Level 1/2 (BTL1/BTL2), GCIA, GCIH, or CySA+ certifications.
  • Cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure, or GCP); scripting (Python or PowerShell); SOAR/automation.
  • Exposure to detection tuning or threat hunting.
  • National Range: 79,589.00 - 114,409.00 USD Annually

Join us at Aristocrat and be part of a team that strives for excellence in every aspect of our operations. Together, we can achieve great things and make an impact on the gaming community worldwide!

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

descriptionHtml:
Be Part of enVista’s Next Chapter

enVista is stronger than ever—focused, energized, and ready to lead the future of supply chain and enterprise consulting. As the premier provider of supply chain technology and strategy services, material handling automation and robotics, Microsoft solutions, and IT managed services, we bring more than 20 years of unmatched domain expertise to thousands of leading brands. We don’t just solve problems, we help our clients transform the way they work, grow, and compete.

The Senior Security Operations Analyst is an experienced individual contributor who independently leads complex investigations, coordinates significant response activities, improves detection and response capabilities, and mentors developing analysts. This role exercises advanced technical judgment across multiple security domains and may own an assigned platform, process, service component, or technical capability.

This is more than just a technical role, it’s an opportunity to be a thought leader and change-maker at a pivotal time in enVista’s journey. We are investing in our people, systems, and future, and we’re looking for bold innovators who want to build with us.

Why enVista?

Our associates are at the forefront of commerce, supply chain, and technology—developing smart, sustainable solutions that improve profitability and positively impact the world. We support our people with comprehensive onboarding and training, award and recognition programs, volunteer and affinity groups, and a strong mentoring culture. We’re committed to growing top talent—and giving them the tools to thrive.

If you’re ready to step into a high-impact role with a company that’s growing, innovating, and leading the market, this is your moment.

Apply today and be part of enVista’s next chapter.

What You Will Do

  • Independently lead complex investigations involving multiple systems, technologies, data sources, or security domains.
  • Correlate endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data to determine incident scope, cause, impact, confidence, and required response.
  • Coordinate technical response activities for significant security incidents and provide timely stakeholder communications.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and develop practical corrective and preventive recommendations.
  • Develop, tune, test, and document security detections, correlation rules, investigative procedures, and response playbooks.
  • Develop scripts, queries, integrations, and workflow automation that improve investigation quality, response time, and service consistency.
  • Lead vulnerability analysis and risk-based remediation discussions with system owners, clients, and technical teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with clients and translate findings into clear business and risk implications.
  • Review analyst investigations, reports, case documentation, and recommendations for quality, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Mentor analysts and provide technical guidance during investigations, escalations, and operational initiatives.
  • Serve as the operational owner for an assigned security platform, process, service component, procedure, or technical capability.
  • Identify material gaps in logging, monitoring, detection coverage, response procedures, or service delivery and lead corrective improvements.
  • Operates independently with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrates advanced technical expertise across multiple security domains.
  • Exercises strong risk-based judgment and communicates recommendations clearly.
  • Serves as a trusted technical resource, reviewer, and mentor.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience
  • 5-8 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial hands-on security operations or incident response responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex investigations and response activities
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID, Azure security technologies, and the Microsoft security ecosystem
  • Experience with cloud security monitoring and cloud security posture management technologies
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, PCI DSS, and related compliance frameworks
  • Experience supporting or governing third-party managed security service providers
  • Experience with phishing simulations, security awareness campaigns, and related communications
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, SC-200, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, GMON, AZ-500, CISSP, or equivalent demonstrated expertise are strongly preferred
  • Experience developing detections, automations, operational improvements, or security workflows
  • Experience presenting technical findings and risk information to clients, business leaders, and technical teams
  • Strong understanding of threat detection, incident response methodologies, and security operations practices
  • This role will be based in our Carmel office in a hybrid capacity

What We Offer

  • Competitive Pay + Performance Bonuses– Your impact matters, and we make sure it shows in your paycheck
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage– Medical, Dental, and Vision and Prescription coverage, along with HSA/FSA options that work for you and your family
  • Time to recharge and give back– Flexible paid time off (PTO), holidays and unlimited volunteering days
  • Paid Sabbatical– After seven years of service, take a well-earned break to rest, recharge, or explore
  • Financial security & retirement– Employed matched 401k, planning and hardship resources, disability and life insurance
  • Flexible Work Options– Balance life and work with hybrid and remote opportunities that support how you thrive
  • Employee Referral Bonus– Know someone amazing? Get rewarded for bringing top talent into the enVista family

Job Summary

Performs advanced monitoring and reporting of security events. Administrates security tools and devices ensuring proper functionality. Conducts investigations providing all required data for incident response.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Supports 24/7 global operations responding to security events in the environment; on-call as required.
  • Performs advanced monitoring of security events; studies and reviews device security logs.
  • Investigates a variety of events by correlating data from various sources to determine the risk to Jabil.
  • Performs advanced incident analysis from logs and monitoring activities.
  • Assists in large-scale security incidents, investigation, and response activities; advises on remediation.
  • Creates/refines log monitoring reports, searches, or basic investigative tools to enhance monitoring.
  • Handles escalations from SOC Security Analysts I.
  • Performs analysis of the environment (e.g. port scans, activity monitoring, intrusion detection).
  • Performs intermediate-level Health Checks and routine administration for security tools.
  • Differentiates between security events or incidents to initiate incident response actions appropriately.
  • Participates in IT security or customer audit activities.
  • Performs mentoring and education for security staff members.
  • Drives continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management.
  • Assures procedures and work instructions are efficient and not redundant.
  • Identifies and implements new analytic methods for detecting threats.
  • Anticipates and meets customer expectations by solving problems quickly and effectively.
  • Maintains confidentiality in all security activities whether internal to Jabil or customer specific.
  • Interprets a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.
  • Lead small projects/initiatives as assigned.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Job Qualifications / Knowledge Requirements

  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to effectively communicate analytical data to varied audiences, including executives.
  • Ability to influence and build credibility as a peer through strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Ability to perform well under significant enterprise-wide pressure with a sense of urgency.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field or 3-5 years Security Operations, Network Administration or equivalent knowledge.
  • Security related certifications: Security +, GSEC, or GCIH
  • Strong working knowledge of perimeter technologies (e.g. firewalls, proxies).
  • Strong working knowledge of security tools (e.g. SIEM, NetFlow, IDS/IPS, endpoint solutions, DLP).
  • Strong working knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, network architecture) and packet capture and analysis.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of operating systems, network services, applications, and security logging.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, or Computer Network Defense.
  • Relevant security related certifications a plus: GCIA, GCED, GMON, CEH, CCNA, CySA +
  • Previous experience in scripting or programming (e.g. Python, PowerShell, PERL, Splunk SPL).
  • Direct experience in an enterprise-level Cyber Incident Response Team or Security Operations Center.

descriptionHtml:
The Cybersecurity Analyst leads Bumble Bee’s day-to-day cybersecurity efforts, serving as the company’s dedicated point of contact for identifying, investigating, and neutralizing cyber threats across the enterprise. Reporting to the Lead Systems Engineer within Information Technology, this role brings focused ownership to a function currently shared across the IT team.

In this role, you’ll investigate and respond to security incidents, hunt for threats before they escalate, and tune detection tooling to reduce noise and close coverage gaps. Including building procedures, playbooks, and exercises that keep the business resilient. Success in this role requires a blend of hands-on technical operations experience and deep cybersecurity expertise.

In addition to cybersecurity expertise, the ideal candidate has experience in compliance, risk management, cloud security, and AI-driven technologies. This position partners cross-functionally to strengthen security posture and ensure regulatory compliance. The Analyst also serves as a liaison to vet external third parties for cyber risk, helping protect the company from lost time, revenue, and reputational harm.

Essential Functions

  • Further develop and mature the security program – Identify, analyze, monitor and manage security events and incidents, owning the full incident response lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with IT to prioritize, validate, and track patching and vulnerability remediation.
  • Collaborate with IT engineers to implement, and optimize SIEM platforms, and fine-tune existing threat detection tools to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Conduct security risk assessments for existing and prospective platforms and vendors, including AI and SaaS solutions.
  • Perform ongoing account auditing and access control reviews, to maintain compliance and reduce risk.
  • Involved in the development and review of enterprise IT policies.
  • Monitor public threat intelligence and vulnerability CVE disclosures to assess business impact and coordinate remediation efforts.
  • Enhance existing cybersecurity tools to strengthen overall organizational security posture.
  • Build, update, and maintain incident response playbooks, procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align business operations with acceptable use standards, ensuring organizational goals are met while enabling the secure adoption of AI-driven technologies.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness through tabletop exercises, phishing prevention, and ongoing user training initiatives.
  • Advise on and assess third-party due diligence for security risk to the Bumble Bee environment, including third-party risk assessments, review of contracts for protections, and third-party training where required (e.g., offshore consultants).
  • Proven ability to collaborate across business units and influence security best practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Skills & Technical Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity or information security roles.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ISC2) preferred.
  • Experience with incident response, threat detection, and log correlation.
  • Proficiency with SIEM platforms and detection engineering.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools (e.g., Tenable, Qualys).
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, command-line tools, and system architecture.
  • Experience with Security Awareness Training platforms.
  • Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS).
  • Experience with governance and endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms (e.g., Microsoft Defender, Purview, Sophos, CrowdStrike).
  • Experience using secure API tools for automation and orchestration.
  • Knowledge of industry frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, SOC, ISO, CIS).
  • Tabletop exercise and penetration testing experience.
  • Understanding data protection, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The health, satisfaction and security of our team members and their families are important to us and an important part of reaching our organization’s goals. We offer a total rewards package that includes valuable competitive compensation and benefit plans. These programs reflect our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent. The compensation for this role includes a base salary and eligibility for an annual bonus based on company performance. All incentive plans are subject to change.

The pay range for this role is $117,000 – $130,000.00 annually to be paid at a salaried rate. *Compensation to commensurate with level of knowledge, education, skills, and experience applicable to the position.

Our current benefits package, which is available to all full-time team members and their eligible dependents, includes:

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • HSA & FSA
  • Life insurance and disability insurance
  • And other voluntary benefits

We also offer time-off benefits including:

  • Paid time-off
  • Sick-flex time
  • 12 company paid holidays

The Team

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join American Tower’s corporate Information Security team. The team protects the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and systems in core systems and platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong tactical and analytical abilities, along with a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles and incident response procedures. In this role, you will use Microsoft Sentinel to oversee the identification, analysis, containment, and remediation of complex security events and work closely with managed detection and response partners.

Responsibilities

What You Can Offer Us

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators and security metrics to measure the effectiveness of the Security Operations Center’s (“SOC”) operations and identify areas for improvement.

JOB SUMMARY: The Security Threat Analyst is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and reporting cyber threats that may affect the organizations systems, data, networks, cloud environments, identities, and business operations. This individual contributor role supports the cybersecurity function by monitoring threat intelligence, analyzing security events, conducting threat hunting, supporting incident response, and translating technical findings into actionable risk-based recommendations.

The role requires applied experience in security operations, cyber threat analysis, incident triage, vulnerability and risk analysis, security monitoring tools, and regulated environment controls. The analyst collaborates with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, compliance, and business partners to strengthen detection capability, reduce exposure to emerging threats, and support timely response to security events.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS AND CORE COMPETENCIES

Threat Monitoring, Analysis, and Triage

Monitor security alerts, threat intelligence feeds, endpoint, identity, cloud, network, email, SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, and related security platforms to identify suspicious or malicious activity.

Analyze indicators of compromise, indicators of attack, malware characteristics, phishing activity, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and emerging cyber threat trends.

Correlate data from multiple security sources to determine threat scope, severity, business impact, and recommended response actions.

Document investigative findings, evidence, timelines, escalation rationale, and recommended remediation actions in accordance with cybersecurity procedures.

Incident Response and Security Operations Support

Support incident response activities, including alert validation, containment coordination, eradication support, recovery follow-up, and post-incident lessons learned.

Escalate confirmed or suspected threats to appropriate cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, compliance, or business stakeholders based on severity and established procedures.

Maintain and update incident response procedures, threat analysis workflows, detection runbooks, and operating guidance.

Coordinate with managed security service providers and internal technology teams to support timely investigation and resolution of security events.

Threat Hunting, Detection Improvement, and Vulnerability Context

Conduct proactive threat hunting using endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry to identify malicious activity that may bypass existing controls.

Support tuning of detection logic, alert thresholds, queries, and use cases to improve security monitoring effectiveness and reduce false positives.

Use vulnerability findings, threat intelligence, and asset criticality to help prioritize remediation recommendations and risk reduction activities.

Support attack surface management, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking in partnership with cybersecurity and technology teams.

Governance, Reporting, Compliance, and Awareness Support

Prepare operational metrics, dashboards, and management reporting related to threat activity, security events, incident trends, and response effectiveness.

Support HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, audit, and evidence collection activities related to security monitoring and incident response controls.

Assist with security awareness activities, phishing simulation follow-up, and communication of cyber threat trends to relevant stakeholders.

Contribute to security policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation as assigned.

Other Duties as Assigned

Qualifications

Education/Specialized Training/Licensure: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required.

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field preferred.

Relevant Cybersecurity Certifications Preferred, Such As

Security+

CySA+

GCIH, GCIA, GSEC, or related SANS certification

CEH

CISSP or associate-level CISSP

Microsoft Security certification

Work Experience (Years and Area): 5 Years' Experience

3+ years of directly related cybersecurity experience.

2+ years of experience in security operations, threat analysis, incident response, vulnerability analysis, or cyber defense monitoring.

Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, identity security, cloud security, email security, vulnerability management, or related cybersecurity platforms.

Experience analyzing security alerts, threat intelligence, indicators of compromise, and incident evidence.

Experience in healthcare, health insurance, managed care, or other regulated technology environments preferred.

Experience supporting HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or audit evidence activities preferred.

Management Experience (Years and Area): This is an individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibility.

Experience coordinating work across cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, compliance, vendor, or managed security service provider teams preferred.

Software Proficiencies

Threat analysis and security event investigation.

Incident triage, evidence documentation, and escalation judgment.

Knowledge of security monitoring tools, SIEM, EDR/XDR, endpoint, identity, cloud, and network security controls.

Analytical thinking, problem analysis, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a time-sensitive security operations environment.

Other

Ability to support managed security service provider coordination.

Ability to communicate cyber threat findings, risks, and recommendations clearly.

Strong business judgment and discretion when handling sensitive security information.

The Cybersecurity Operations Senior Analyst is responsible for security monitoring, investigations, incident response, threat analysis, detection engineering, and technical leadership within the Security Operations Center. This position serves as a senior technical resource and is expected to exercise sound technical judgment while working collaboratively with other analysts and cross-functional teams to investigate complex security events, correlate disparate enterprise data sources, identify anomalous or malicious behavior, and develop technically defensible findings and recommendations. The Senior Analyst is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively with peers and subject-matter experts, contribute to team objectives, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other analysts.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor for Security Events & Advanced Threat Analysis - 40%

  • Lead advanced monitoring and analysis of enterprise security events and telemetry.
  • Provide timely detection, identification, investigation, and escalation of potential attacks, intrusions, anomalous activity, and misuse.
  • Lead proactive threat hunting based on emerging threats, adversary behaviors, organizational risk, and observed trends.
  • Correlate data across SIEM, EDR, identity, network, cloud, email, and other enterprise data sources to identify anomalous or malicious behavior.
  • Develop, validate, tune, and maintain detection rules, investigative queries, notifications, and reporting capabilities.
  • Evaluate detection effectiveness and recommend improvements based on investigative findings and observed behavior.
  • Identify telemetry, logging, and detection gaps and develop appropriate recommendations or alternative investigative approaches.

Respond to Incidents & Lead Complex Investigations - 35%

  • Lead complex cybersecurity investigations from initial detection through containment, remediation, recovery, and closure.
  • Serve as a senior incident lead and technical resource during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Coordinate incident-response activities across Security and partner teams.
  • Determine appropriate investigative approaches, data sources, technical pivots, and evidence necessary to support investigative findings.
  • Collaborate with analysts, infrastructure teams, application owners, and other subject-matter experts when their expertise is necessary to investigate or resolve an incident.
  • Provide technical support during an incident as required.
  • Write and distribute detailed incident reports and after-action reviews.
  • Identify lessons learned and recommend improvements to security controls, detections, telemetry, procedures, and response capabilities.
  • Produce executive-level incident summaries and communicate complex technical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Security Research & Technical Leadership - 25%

  • Conduct enterprise-wide research into emerging threats, vulnerabilities, adversary techniques, technologies, and defensive practices.
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for other SOC analysts.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship while promoting collaboration and shared accountability across the team.
  • Develop and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, procedures, investigative methodologies, and technical documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve SOC detection coverage, investigative capabilities, operational efficiency, and response maturity.
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional cybersecurity initiatives requiring technical analysis.
  • Provide daily, periodic, trend, and executive-level reporting regarding security activity and/or emerging risk.
  • Share investigative techniques, technical knowledge, and lessons learned to improve overall team capability.

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Certifications & KSA)

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or a related discipline preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • 5-7 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including experience in security operations, security investigations, incident response, or related cybersecurity functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex or ambiguous technical problems, determine appropriate next steps, and work collaboratively with relevant resources toward resolution.
  • Demonstrated ability to correlate information from multiple security technologies and data sources to develop defensible conclusions and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, identity, network, endpoint, and other cybersecurity technologies.
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and investigative methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, provide technical guidance, accept and incorporate feedback, and contribute to the development of other analysts.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in high-accountability environments where individual ownership, team success, operational discipline, and timely execution are essential.
  • Advanced cybersecurity certifications in areas such as incident response/DFIR, security architecture, cloud security, offensive security, detection engineering, or related disciplines are preferred but not required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

Our diverse business portfolio allows employees broad career options with the advantage of staying with the same organization.

About The Opportunity

DMI, LLC is looking for a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst with hands-on experience monitoring, detecting, and analyzing threats and cybersecurity events to identify and defend against validated intrusion events . Daily work includes monitoring network and system security events, conducting threat hunting through event data and activity logs, developing alarms for suspicious or malicious activity, escalating alerts to clients, and preparing reports to summarize detected activities.

The SOC Analyst executes and helps to create operational processes for consistent monitoring of client environments and should be familiar with a variety of security tools and technologies. The SOC Analyst additionally works to support the Incident Response Team by conducting monitoring and analysis during incident management engagements.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Work the mid shift, 3:00 p.m - 11:30 p.m., five days per week on a fixed Sunday–Thursday or Tuesday–Saturday schedule, including State holidays when scheduled.
  • Monitor, protect, and defend the enterprise perimeter against malicious network traffic.
  • Monitor, protect, and defend internal networks and hosts against ongoing and emerging threats.
  • Enrich monitoring logs with contextual operation data from functional areas correlate events and identify security issues, threats, and vulnerabilities
  • Conduct security event analysis and validation, triage validated incidents, perform initial containment where feasible, research incident and enrich incident case documentation, and escalate the incident for further analysis, containment, and eradication.
  • Review and analyze threat intelligence information and proactively search application, system, network logs to hunt for and thwart relevant threats identified threats.
  • Prepare and perform shift handover briefing to communicate completed and pending activities, and relay situational awareness information.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOC Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Concept of Operations (CONOPS) to establish and continuously improve organization's operating knowledge base.
  • Participate in post-incident activities and contribute to lessons learned to improve security operations.
  • Provide support in preparation of management threat reports and briefings, and recommendations.
  • Provide sound technical recommendations that enable remediation of security issues.
  • Partner with security engineering to develop and refine SIEM correlation rules.
  • Utilize advanced threat models, SIEM use cases, and incident response playbooks.

Qualifications

 Education and Years of Experience:

  • 5–8 years of experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or a related scientific or technical disciplines . Master's Degree is preferred.
  • CompTIA CySA+ certification/ or a CompTIA Security+ (or other relevant IAT Level II/III Certification) along with one of the following:
    • CEH
    • CFR
    • CCNA Cyber Ops
    • CCNA-Security
    • GCIA
    • GCIH
    • GICSP
    • Cloud+
    • SCYBER
    • PenTest+
  • Experience analyzing intrusion events such phishing emails, malware, privileges misuse, traffic indicating potential malicious activities such DoS/DDoS, brute force, data loss through exfiltration/ inadvertent disclosure.
  • Applied experience of threat analysis model/frameworks such Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model, Pyramid of Pain etc.
  • Working knowledge of advanced threat Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs).
  • Applied experience with network traffic analysis with tools like Wireshark
  • Applied experience with a variety of Opensource threat research tools/platforms such as Virus Total
  • Working knowledge of network and security architecture principles such as defense-in-depth
  • Experience with proprietary security protection/detections tools such as Firewall, Host and Network IDS/IPS, Anti-Virus, EDR, URL Filtering Gateways, Email Filtering Gateways, DLP tools, and SIEM tools such as Splunk etc.
  • Capable of working independently, establishing priorities and managing task completion within set SLAs
  • Able to communicate effectively through writing, speaking, and presenting to client technical representatives.
  • Team player capable of productively contributing to the client mission by supporting fellow teammates in a dynamic growing and changing environment.
Desired Skills And Qualifications

  • Experience with mid-to-advance level malware analysis
  • Experience creating detailed queries and scripts, such as regular expressions, for log, event and correlation analysis.
  • Experience scripting in Python, PowerShell, VBScript

descriptionHtml:
Why Work at Banner?

For over 50 years, Banner Engineering has been at the forefront of industrial automation. We offer products and solutions including award-winning sensors, wireless solutions, machine safety, indication and LED lighting. From Fortune 500 leaders to innovative startups, Banner's award-winning products and solutions are helping companies around the world increase efficiency, reduce costs, safeguard equipment, and protect personnel. Our commitment to innovation shows through a continuous, market-driven evolution of products and technology. With engineers employed in nearly every major department, engineering is in our DNA.

Banner is a rapidly growing company that offers many personal development opportunities, an excellent benefits package, and a collaborative team of employees who are passionate about what they do.

Position Summary

The Information Security Analyst plays a key role in supporting the Cybersecurity department by owning day-to-day triage, investigation, and response for security alerts across the organization, and by helping improve Banner’s security monitoring and detection capabilities. Your work will span alerts from insider risk, EDR, SIEM, DLP, MDR and other detection sources protecting Banner’s information systems, networks, and manufacturing environments. You will also operate security controls, manage vulnerabilities, and report on risk and compliance, contributing to the success of Banner’s information security program and business goals.

The Information Security Analyst works closely with IT infrastructure, OT/manufacturing, engineering, and business teams to ensure Banner’s data, systems, and intellectual property remain secure and compliant. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills and a proven ability to reduce risk while enabling the business. This role serves as the primary day-to-day resource for security operations, working closely with the Manager of Cybersecurity on escalation, major incidents, control improvements, and security projects. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

This position reports to the Manager of Cybersecurity.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working both individually and collaboratively, staying on top of a steady flow of alerts and tasks, and making a meaningful impact across teams and projects. Below are some key responsibilities of the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and support security technologies such as endpoint protection, SASE, firewall, network security technologies, email security, identity and access management, and vulnerability management tools.
  • Monitor and triage alerts from security tooling (EDR, SIEM, DLP, MDR, and insider risk) across corporate and manufacturing environments.
  • Investigate suspicious activity to determine scope and impact, and recommend next steps.
  • Contain or escalate incidents according to Banner’s Incident Response Plan, and lead or support incident response activities.
  • Document incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews and updates to response procedures.
  • Tune detection rules and reduce false positives across monitoring tools.
  • Develop playbooks and automate repetitive triage steps to speed up response.
  • Perform vulnerability and exposure scanning and assessments, analyze results, and coordinate with system owners to prioritize and track remediation.
  • Collaborate with IT infrastructure, OT/manufacturing, engineering, and business stakeholders to embed security into projects, systems, and processes.
  • Track and report on security metrics, risk, and compliance status, ensuring visibility of outcomes to leadership.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation related to security configurations, standards, and procedures.
  • Support customer, audit, and regulatory security questionnaires and assessments (e.g., C-TPAT, cybersecurity frameworks).
  • Identify opportunities to improve security processes, detection capabilities, workflows, and tools; recommend practical improvements; and support implementation under the direction of the Cybersecurity Manager.
  • Uphold compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Support security awareness, training, and onboarding initiatives to foster a security-minded culture.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Bring To The Table

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily, and regular attendance is required. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to support individuals with disabilities.

Required

  • A minimum of 2+ years of experience in information security, security operations, or a related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience with security tools and platforms such as SIEM/MDR, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, firewalls, and identity and access management
  • Experience monitoring and responding to security events on Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, with familiarity tuning alerts to improve fidelity and reduce false positives, and knowledge of network protocols, firewalls, and intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS)
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, collaborate across teams, and manage ambiguity
  • Ability to work independently on routine security operations, exercise sound judgment in escalating higher-risk matters, and communicate findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows, Active Directory/Entra ID, and network fundamentals
  • Passion for protecting people, data, and systems in support of Banner’s mission and people-first culture

Preferred

  • Previous experience in a manufacturing or industrial automation environment
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and C-TPAT
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GIAC such as GCIH or GCIA, Microsoft SC-200, CISSP)
  • Experience working in a remote or hybrid, fast-paced team environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, contribute to initiatives, and analyze security data
  • Experience scripting or automating triage and response tasks (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Familiarity with adversary tactics and techniques (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK), attacker-detection approaches, and incident-handling practices
  • Familiarity with OT/ICS security concepts and a strong interest in industry security trends

What To Expect At Work

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to support individuals with disabilities.

  • Sit for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Continuous movement, walking, or standing.
  • Exposed to a computer screen for extended periods
  • May require repetitive motions such as utilize a computer mouse, keyboard, computer, and other standard office equipment.
  • Communicate with others frequently.
    • Occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds.
    • Ability to work on-site in a manufacturing environment and travel to other facilities when needed.
Working Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those you may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • Corporate office environment – indoor and climate-controlled
  • Frequent interaction with internal departments, cross-functional teams, and external partners and vendors, as well as employees across all levels of the organization—including entry-level staff and senior leadership.
  • Exposure to moderate noise, moving mechanical parts, and temperature changes in production areas.
  • PPE may be required in specific areas (e.g., safety glasses, hearing protection)
  • Standard hours Monday through Friday; occasional overtime, weekend, or after-hours work may be required to respond to critical security incidents, and travel to other facilities may be required
  • Exposure to various manufacturing, warehousing, or related industrial locations.

Pay And Benefits

Banner Engineering is committed to offering competitive pay and benefits, including, but not limited to:

  • 401(k) with match
  • Student Loan 401(k) match program
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans
  • HSA (Health Savings Account) with company contribution
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Sales and Profit Sharing Eligibility
  • Flexible work hours
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Pet Insurance

Base Pay Range: $82,245.00 - $116,033.00

The estimated range is the budgeted amount for this position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

Core Values

Customer Driven, Accountability Focused, Integrity Always, New Solutions – Every Day

If you excel in a dynamic, collaborative environment and are looking for meaningful challenges and opportunities to grow, you’ll find a great fit here. Banner Engineering is a premier employer headquartered in MN, offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional development as we rapidly grow in the Industrial Automation industry.

Banner Engineering is an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025 , a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Cyber Security Analyst will be responsible for monitoring and responding to active threats and alerts occurring on customer networks and being part of a next generation Security Operations Center (SOC). Security Analysts will leverage various industry leading tools and methodologies to rapidly investigate potential threats, building new professional skills and capabilities along the way, all the while providing superior service to our customers. Selected candidates will also leverage and work with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, customer specific triage workflows, automation tools and SOAR platforms.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leverage various security tools to perform monitoring and analysis of security events/data to identify security risks and threats on customer networks.
  • Utilize cyber hunt techniques to discover violations or threats.
  • Implement, administer, and use cybersecurity tools, systems and applications; develop policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure secure enterprise-wise operations, performance and resiliency.
  • Deploy and secure security systems, application layer and traditional firewalls, vulnerability management and forensics utilities, and other infrastructure deployed and maintained by the Information Security Office.
  • Develop plans to safeguard information against unauthorized access modification, and destruction, and ensure organizational continuity of operations.
  • Work with SIEM solutions such as Splunk and others to perform investigation and triage of incidents.
  • Working with your team and broader True Zero community to stay up to date on the latest security trends and threats to improve the effectiveness of security programs for our customers.
  • Following processes and procedures and providing refinement suggestions for them.
  • Performing detailed documentation efforts to report on all investigative steps performed and coordinating with external teams/personnel.

Position Requirements

  • Minimum 6-7+ years relevant experience
  • Bachelors Degree preferred
  • Security+/CISSP preferred
  • U.S. Citizenship as this position is for a U.S. federal customer
  • Hands on experience working with enterprise SIEM solutions, Splunk preferred.
  • Working knowledge of networking principles (TCP/UDP, ICMP, etc.), application protocols (i.e. HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, DHCP, etc.) and common operating systems
  • Basic understanding of Active Directory and LDAP
  • Ability to obtain then maintain a clearance may be required

descriptionHtml:
At Aristocrat, we are passionate about delivering world-class gaming experiences that bring happiness to millions of players worldwide. We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Security Operations Analyst (Tier 2) to join our team. As part of our Security Operations Center, you will play a crucial role in protecting our digital assets and maintaining our flawless security standards. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to collaborate with global teams, grow within a structured mentoring program, and build your career in a modern SOC environment. If you are ambitious and ready to compete at the highest level, this role is for you!

What You'll Do

  • Own MSSP customer concerns and medium/high-severity alerts from start to finish. Scope the activity and build the timeline. Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and investigate endpoint, identity, network, and cloud data to reach a defensible conclusion.
  • Review a sample of MSSP triage for quality, offering tuning, detection-gap, and escalation-criteria feedback to the MSSP.
  • Triage phishing (header analysis, sandboxing), malware (static & sandbox), and credential-compromise investigations.
  • Complete containment and remediation within approved playbooks — host isolation, account disablement, credential reset, IOC blocking — and record every action taken.
  • Raise issues to senior specialists with a full set of information: hypothesis, evidence, actions taken, current risk, and specific ask; send well-understood benign patterns back to the MSSP along with a detailed disposition and the missing playbook step.
  • Build and run queries across our SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms and MSSP tooling to support investigations and reporting.
  • Identify detection and tuning gaps. Flag false positives and propose tuning, suppression, or enrichment with supporting evidence. Test and validate detection changes shipped by the detection engineering team.
  • Document every case to a high standard. Ensure it is complete, accurate, and reproducible by someone not on shift. Accept peer and lead QA review. Act on feedback within the same cycle.
  • Support specialist-led threat hunts and incident response — evidence gathering and technical analysis from detection through root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Contribute to playbook, runbook, and knowledge-base improvements drawn from your own casework.
  • Participate in the 24x7 rotating shift roster, including on-call and occasional weekend coverage.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on SOC / security operations experience, with ownership of investigations beyond initial triage.
  • A bachelor's degree in information systems, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Query proficiency on our CrowdStrike stack — CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) — or transferable SIEM query experience (e.g., KQL, SPL); plus hands-on EDR (live response, process-tree analysis, host isolation).
  • Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory (AD) / Entra ID attack patterns; comfortable reading authentication, process, and network logs without a playbook.
  • A solid grasp of the incident-response process, phishing and malware investigations; MITRE ATT&CK for mapping observed behavior.
  • Nice to have: Security+, ISC2 SSCP, Microsoft SC-200, CrowdStrike (CCFA/CCFR), Blue Team Level 1/2 (BTL1/BTL2), GCIA, GCIH, or CySA+ certifications.
  • Cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure, or GCP); scripting (Python or PowerShell); SOAR/automation.
  • Exposure to detection tuning or threat hunting.
  • National Range: 79,589.00 - 114,409.00 USD Annually

Join us at Aristocrat and be part of a team that strives for excellence in every aspect of our operations. Together, we can achieve great things and make an impact on the gaming community worldwide!

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Cybersecurity Analyst to join our team in Doral, FL.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Monitoring enterprise networks, security information and event management (SIEM) systems, and defensive sensors to detect cyber threats.
  • Executing vulnerability scans, analyzing security logs, and coordinating remediation workflows across operational systems.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, system administrators, and leadership to maintain compliance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) standards.
  • Conducting security incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reporting cyber security events to operational leadership.
  • Maintaining system security baselines, baseline documentation, and configuration management controls across physical and virtual assets.
  • Performing routine compliance audits, STIG assessments, and security validation checks across enterprise infrastructure.
  • Recommending and implementing continuous process improvements to optimize defensive cyber capabilities and threat monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity or information assurance.
    • OR a master’s degree and 3+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR an associate’s degree and 7+ or more years of relevant experience
    • OR a high school diploma and 9+ or more years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience performing cybersecurity analysis, vulnerability assessments, security monitoring, and incident investigation.
  • Strong background in Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53 security controls, and DoD STIG compliance implementation.
  • Experience maintaining system baselines, security documentation controls, and vulnerability tracking records.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical documentation and cybersecurity compliance reports.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or CompTIA CySA+.

Clearance Requirements

  • Must hold a current/active TS/SCI security clearance.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • IAT Level II certification required (GSEC, Security+, SSCP, or CCNA-Security)
  • Proficient in Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Experience working in a Cybersecurity Operations Center environment
  • Familiarity with COTS technologies used in a Cybersecurity Operations Center
  • Working knowledge of database and operating system security
  • Solid understanding of current security principles, techniques, and protocols

  • CSSP-IR certification (CySA+, CEH)
  • Ability to function in a fast-paced environment and effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously, coordinating resources and ensuring scheduled goals are met
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with various levels of senior management
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities—able to seek out information, evaluate, prioritize, and implement best practices
  • Must be able to multi-task, work independently and collaboratively, share workloads, and adapt to shifts in project priorities

Job Description

About SkyWest

SkyWest is the largest regional airline in the United States and partners with four major airline carriers. More importantly, we’re known for our reliability, service, and our professional employees who operate flights each day throughout North America. We have been esteemed as one of America’s Best Employers by Forbes and are known for an industry-leading workforce, an exceptional leadership team, and our continued solid operational and economic performance.

SkyWest employees enjoy a distinctive and unmatched culture of teamwork, respect, quality, and professionalism, along with world-class benefits such as:

  • 401(k) match
  • Performance Rewards and Profit Sharing
  • Health care (medical, dental, and vision)
  • Discounted worldwide flight benefits and free on available open seating for you and your family with four of our major airlines (Delta, United, Alaska, and American)

Primary Job Duties

Protects SkyWest’s systems, data and operations by detecting and responding to threats, managing vulnerabilities and supporting security governance and compliance. Works with infrastructure and application teams to strengthen cybersecurity controls and helps the company use AI safely.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage and investigate alerts across SIEM, endpoint, email security and other detection tools. Escalate and respond according to the incident response plan, including after hours when needed.
  • Take part in incident response: containment, evidence collection, root-cause analysis and reporting. Help build and test incident response playbooks.
  • Run vulnerability scanning and track fixes with system owners. Confirm fixes and report on risk trends.
  • Work with infrastructure teams on hardening standards (CIS Benchmarks, encryption, firewall rules) and regularly test that security controls and detection rules work as intended.
  • Support compliance (TSA, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOX), audit evidence, access reviews (including privileged and service accounts) and upkeep of security policies.
  • Coordinate and participate in penetration tests and vendor security reviews.
  • Administer the security awareness program, with primary responsibility for phishing simulations and training: plan and run campaigns, track results, follow up with users who need more help, and report on trends.
  • Support secure and authorized AI use: review tools and integration for data exposure and access risks. Help enforce the acceptable-use policy, especially identifying and preventing unapproved AI use.
  • Use automation and AI tools to speed up triage, analysis and reporting, and check their output before acting on it.
  • Stay current on threats affecting IT and aviation, using CISA advisories and industry threat-sharing sources. Keep documentation and runbooks up to date.

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years of IT experience in a corporate environment, including at least 2 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience
  • Hands-on experience with security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, and remediation, including cloud and SaaS environments
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and best practices, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and CIS Controls
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity risk assessments, compliance activities, security investigations, and evaluating the effectiveness of security controls
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify security risks and recommend practical solutions
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical security risks to non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to take initiative, work independently, collaborate with others, and prioritize competing responsibilities in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to successfully complete required background checks and meet applicable TSA requirements for access to Sensitive Security Information (SSI)
  • CISSP certification, Security+ certification, a degree in Information Security and Risk Management, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related major is preferred but not required

Physical And Other Requirements

  • Sitting for long periods of time
  • Only online applications will be considered
  • Security+, CySA+, GIAC (GSEC, GCIH), CISSP or similar certification (equivalent practical experience considered)
  • Scripting (Python, PowerShell) or SOAR experience
  • Familiarity with AI security risks and guidance
  • Aviation or other regulated, critical-infrastructure experience
  • This is not a Department of Transportation safety-sensitive position.

POSITION TITLE: Information Security Analyst

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP: IT Manager

PAY STRUCTURE: Salary

PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION: The Information Security Analyst supports the security and integrity of the company's information systems and data. This position monitors and investigates security events, supports vulnerability and access management, assists with data loss prevention and compliance activities, and helps administer security controls associated with enterprise systems and approved AI technologies. The position also supports employee security awareness and the development and maintenance of information security and AI governance practices.

Background Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years in security operations, IT administration, or a related analyst role.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/EDR tools and Microsoft 365 security and compliance tools, including Purview and Entra ID.
  • Experience with, or a demonstrated interest in, generative AI tools and their associated data-governance risks.
  • Industry-recognized certifications are preferred, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or relevant Microsoft Security or AI certifications.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Monitor SIEM, EDR, IDS, and other security-related events; triage, investigate, document, and escalate incidents.
  • Run phishing simulations and security awareness training for employees.
  • Review user access events, including privileged account access and security logs on a regular schedule.
  • Administer enterprise AI platforms, including approved generative AI tools; review licensing, settings, connectors, token usage, and permissions; configure and monitor AI tools to restrict access to authorized information.
  • Monitor and assist in DLP design and implementation, including the assessment of sensitivity labels and access controls.
  • Assist in the drafting and maintenance of the AI acceptable-use policy and review requests for new AI tools and vendors.
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation, audits, and collection of compliance evidence.

On-site

First Shift
